STATE COLLEGE ↔ TAIWAN

Entrepreneurship is global. So is the opportunity to learn.

Asia-Pacific Academic’s recap of the 2025 Penn State program names faculty leaders Ted Graef, Brad Groznik, and Angela Rothrock. Students connected with technology companies, academic partners, and innovation spaces while exploring local culture.

Partners named in the recap include National Taipei University of Technology, Taiwan Tech Arena, OnLogic, TAILYN Technologies, TESDA, the TSMC Museum of Innovation, and ViewSonic.

Read the program recap+Ask about future opportunities+

This is a past-program recap. Contact E-SHIP for future dates, eligibility, costs, and how to apply. Source: Asia-Pacific Academic.
